name: clarity-workflows
description: A visual, human-controlled graph for bounded AI-assisted research and coding workflows.

interface.longDescription: Organize papers, books, datasets, hypotheses, code, and results as a visual graph. Use two adjustable validation gates around side-effect-free ChatGPT reasoning and require explicit human approval before a candidate becomes part of the graph.
defaultPrompt: Open my Clarity research graph and show me the active evidence paths.
Use Clarity to inspect my current graph, ask me which real source nodes to use, pressure-test a hypothesis, and stage the result for my approval.
